description: This Java class, SelfClientDataValidator, provides validation logic for client-related API requests within the Apache Fineract project. It checks for unsupported query parameters in URI info objects, ensuring correct API usage and throwing exceptions for invalid parameters.

classes.name: SelfClientDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating query parameters in client data API requests. It enforces restrictions on supported association parameters and 'exclude' parameter, as well as validation for template requests.

methods.name: validateClientCharges
methods.description: Validates that only supported association parameters and 'exclude' are used in the request URI. Throws UnsupportedParameterException if unsupported parameters are found.

methods.name: validateRetrieveOne
methods.description: Validates that only supported parameters, like 'template,' are used in a 'retrieve one' API request. Throws UnsupportedParameterException if unsupported parameters are present.
